editorial:
Imagine you are a young woman just trying to make some extra cash by baby-sitting for a nice family. That is where you meet Michelle. Everything seems normal until the mother of the house suddenly passes away. Instead of letting her go, the father asks Michelle to stay on and help with the kids. You can feel the tension building as the father starts moving in on her, using the tragedy to get closer to her. It feels like a cozy family drama at first, but it quickly turns into a game of cat and mouse where you are not quite sure who is playing whom.

The acting is solid and keeps you interested even when the plot slows down. While some of the twists might feel a bit predictable if you have seen a lot of 90s thrillers, the chemistry between the leads makes it work. If you enjoy stories about secrets and forbidden romance, you will like this one. Since it is an older flick, you might want to look for a remastered version. I suggest renting it on Apple TV for a quick watch or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you love these kinds of hidden gems.
endingExplained: You will find out that the father was not just a grieving widower. He had a dark plan to manipulate Michelle to get what he wanted. In the end, the truth about his past and his true intentions come to light. Michelle realizes she is in danger and manages to escape his grasp. The movie wraps up with her getting away from the toxic household, leaving the father to face the consequences of his lies.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and domestic dramas.
